purpose: Test safe path traversal sequence against static file download/view endpoints.
expected_secure_behavior: Server sanitizes or rejects path segments, resolving only inside authorized public root directory.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server traverses out of intended directory and streams system file contents.
remediation: Resolve absolute paths with path.resolve() and verify path.resolve(base, input).startsWith(base). Reject inputs containing '..' or null bytes.

expected_secure_behavior: Input is rejected or path traversal is prevented by canonicalizing path.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Server decodes URL sequence after validation and exposes arbitrary files.
remediation: Validate input after all decodings or strictly use whitelist identifiers (e.g. file ID from database).
